patterns.note: Full-bleed dramatic photography or video backgrounds are used for major section heroes, with large, stark text overlays.
A strong contrast between oversized, widely-spaced uppercase headings and smaller, often uppercase, monospace or clean sans-serif body/label text.
The site alternates between dark (near-black) sections with white text and light (pale blue-grey) sections with dark text, creating a high-contrast visual rhythm.
Hero sections feature a strong parallax effect where large background images scroll at a slower rate than the overlaid text and central content, creating depth.
Key narrative sections are introduced with a two-line, large-text heading that spans the width of the viewport, set against a full-bleed background image.

technique_notes: Hero sections utilize a video background (as detected) or large static image with a dark overlay for text contrast, combined with a parallax scrolling effect where the background moves slower than the foreground text and elements.
The primary navigation transforms from a transparent, spread-out link list to a sticky, semi-transparent dark bar with a consolidated menu button after scrolling past the initial hero section.
Content sections appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, widely-spaced uppercase headings (~4-5x body) provide dramatic impact, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif and monospace labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all corners are crisp and angular, with no visible rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous spacing is used around major sections and headings, creating a sense of openness, while some text blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dramatic, full-bleed photography and video combined with stark, oversized typography and strong parallax effects creates a powerful, immersive narrative experience that feels both minimalist and epic.
